# omada_service_type (Resource)

Manages a custom service type: a reusable protocol/port definition that firewall and QoS rules can reference.

The controller ships twelve built-ins (`ALL`, `FTP`, `SSH`, `TELNET`, …) marked `is_builtin`. Those are reference data — reference them by id, but do not try to manage them here; this resource is for custom definitions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A reusable protocol/port definition for firewall and QoS rules.
#
# The controller's twelve built-ins (ALL, FTP, SSH, TELNET, …) are reference
# data: reference them by id, but manage only custom ones here.
resource "omada_service_type" "grafana" {
  name              = "grafana"
  protocol          = 0 # what the built-in TCP services use on this firmware
  source_ports      = "0-65535"
  destination_ports = "3000-3000"
  description       = "Grafana UI"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `destination_ports` (String) Destination port range, e.g. `8080-8080`.
- `name` (String) Service type name.
- `protocol` (Number) Protocol, as a controller enum. On the firmware this was developed against `0` is what the built-in TCP services (FTP, SSH, TELNET) use and `2` is what `ALL` uses. TP-Link does not document the mapping — check an existing service type with the `omada_service_types` listing before guessing.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `icmp_code` (Number) ICMP code, for protocols that use it.
- `icmp_type` (Number) ICMP type, for protocols that use it.
- `site` (String) Site name. Defaults to the primary site. Changing forces replacement.
- `source_ports` (String) Source port range, e.g. `0-65535`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `is_builtin` (Boolean) Whether this is one of the controller's built-in service types. Read-only.
- `site_id` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By service-type ID, or "<site>/<id>".
terraform import omada_service_type.grafana 6a6617f6bb62a10bd62d0926
```
